name: attempt_id
description: Unique identifier for this processing attempt. Primary key.

name: hand_start_id
description: hand_starts.hand_start_id being processed. Foreign key to hand_starts.hand_start_id.

name: status
description: Outcome of this attempt: 'complete' | 'complete_skipped' | 'marked_pending' | 'failed_transient' | 'failed_permanent' | 'failed_parked'. 'complete_skipped' means a precondition check failed and no LLM calls were made. 'failed_parked' means the retry cap was reached and the hand start will no longer be selected. Both are terminal, as are 'complete' and 'failed_permanent'; 'failed_transient' and 'marked_pending' are re-selected. 'marked_pending' is written by `tt mark-pending`, not by an attempt: it is retryable and resets the consecutive-failure count, so a mark grants a full retry budget. No in-flight states. NOT enforced as an enum by BigQuery — validation lives in application code.

name: status_message
description: Free-form error, skip-reason, or status detail. Typically populated on failure or skip to capture the reason. NULL on success.

name: attempted_at
description: Timestamp when this attempt was recorded. Auto-populated on insert via DEFAULT.
